description: 73 cyber-threat-intelligence tools — threats, SPL/KQL/Sigma detections, IOCs, actors, C2, MITRE ATT&CK. Purple tier.
long_description:
Threadlinqs Intelligence is a premium cyber-threat-intelligence MCP server. It exposes 73 tools across curated threats, detection logic (Splunk SPL / Microsoft KQL / Sigma), IOCs, threat actors, C2 infrastructure, MITRE ATT&CK chains, CVE/CWE, correlations, and Purple-tier composite/aggregation intelligence — plus prompts, resources (threadlinqs:// URIs), completions, and STIX 2.1 / ATT&CK Navigator export.

This is a **Purple-tier feature (tier >= 3, Purple + Gold plans)**. The server starts without a key so clients and registries can introspect the catalog, but every tool CALL is gated server-side and requires a valid Purple/Gold key — there is no free or anonymous access to intelligence data. Get a key at https://intel.threadlinqs.com/profile. Note that signing up alone lands you on Blue (tier 1) — a 7-day Purple trial is offered at checkout on the pricing page, not on signup.

Prefer zero-install? The same server is available as a remote connector at https://intel.threadlinqs.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1).
